policies.text: A plan or recommendation made for the user holds only while the personal circumstances it was based on still hold.
A reminder the user asked for stays scheduled until the user cancels it.
A preference the user stated applies to every later recommendation of the same kind.

updates.text: The user said: "I’m still getting used to planning my weeks around the train timetable again—turns out the monthly commuter pass is a lot cheaper than constantly topping up my card, but it feels strange not being able to duck out mid‑afternoon without thinking about rush hour."

The user said: "After moving into this new place where my entrance is down a long interior hallway and the windows look out over a parking lot, I’ve realized I barely recognize anyone in the building beyond a couple of faces."
The user said: "Ever since I started watching things while I’m cooking, I’ve been leaning hard on the TV’s audio description track—otherwise I miss half the plot when I’m not looking at the screen."
The user said: "The new lease kicked in this week, and the movers hauled the last of my boxes out of the old place—anything left behind is gone for good now."

The user said: "I’m filling out the paperwork for my long-term move to Tokyo next spring, so I’ve been ruthless about downsizing—only two suitcases’ worth is coming with me, and everything else is getting sold or donated over the next few months."
